extra.message: User-controlled chat data (chatMessage.author.name and chatMessage.message from websocket messages) is concatenated into an HTML string and assigned to p.innerHTML. This is a stored XSS vulnerability: a malicious user can send a chat message containing script that executes in every recipient's browser.

User-controlled value user.emailAddress is passed to jQuery's replaceWith(), which parses string arguments as HTML. Since emailAddress is supplied by users at registration and rendered raw, an attacker can inject arbitrary HTML/script (stored XSS) executed when another user clicks 'show contact'.

The profile link renders user.webPageUrl with target="_blank" but without rel="noopener noreferrer". A user-controlled external page opened this way retains window.opener access and can redirect the parent tab to a phishing page (reverse tabnabbing).

cwe: CWE-1022: Use of Web Link to Untrusted Target with window.opener Access

extra.message: The STOMP websocket connection authenticates with hardcoded credentials client.connect('asdf', 'were', ...) instead of the logged-in user's actual session/credentials. Any client can subscribe to the user notification queue using these shared credentials, bypassing real authentication.

cwe: CWE-306: Missing Authentication for Critical Function

extra.message: State-changing requests are made with credentials: 'include' (cookie-based session) and no CSRF token is sent. An attacker can forge cross-site requests (e.g., PUT /rest/user to create a user, PUT /rest/messages/chat, GET /logout) that are executed with the victim's session. The same pattern appears in src/Users.js:143, src/Users.js:109, src/Login.js:30, and src/App.js:40.

The full login response (loggedInUser) is serialized and stored in window.localStorage, along with the authentication flag. localStorage is readable by any script in the origin and persists indefinitely, so an XSS can steal the stored session/user data, and logout only clears it on the client.

cwe: CWE-922: Insecure Storage of Sensitive Information
